text: Question: 'From Neurotypical developed'? However, be prepared of >10 Minutes invest... without knowing if its worth, without knowing how this app will look and feel... this app is not 'for ADHD people' if the inital setup will you drive crazy...
author: Paul K.
developer_reply: Thank you for this honest feedback The initial experience should feel accessible and ADHD-friendly, not overwhelming or exhausting. We’re taking this feedback seriously as we continue improving the onboarding experience. You can reach out to us here: support@shimmer.care
